description: Mark Yonkman is a Michigan farmer and lifelong advocate for rural communities, running for State Senate in District 36. Farming shaped his values of hard work, responsibility, and stewardship. Mark understands the challenges facing family farms, small businesses, and working families, and is committed to protecting agriculture, strengthening local economies, and giving rural Michigan a strong, common-sense voice in Lansing.
